title: Detector where-git candidate order was underspecified
description: The draft named bin/usr-bin candidates but did not require the exact launcher order or both cmd/bin git.exe fixtures.
resolution: Plan and stories now require parent ../bin/bash.exe, sibling ./bash.exe, parent ../usr/bin/bash.exe ordering plus cmd-layout and bin-layout tests.

title: Model-facing shell hint tests missed explicit Bash override
description: The draft tested feature-off PowerShell and feature-on Git Bash but could miss explicit default_shell/user_shell_override selecting Bash with the feature off.
resolution: Plan and stories now require shell_spec and environment_context tests to derive hints from Session::user_shell, including explicit Bash override with the feature off.
